name: com.headlesslaw/headlesslaw
title: headlesslaw MCP server
description: Verbatim text of EU financial and digital regulation, with official sources. Not legal advice.

tools.name: searchDocumentation
tools.description: Search the headlesslaw corpus: the verbatim text of EU financial and digital regulation (Level 1 acts, their Level 2 technical standards and Level 3 guidelines and Q&As) and the definitions. Returns matching passages, each with its page title and page address. Use getPage with a returned address to read the whole page. Results are the official text as published on the site, without commentary.

tools.name: getPage
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown of one page of the headlesslaw corpus by its address (for example https://www.headlesslaw.com/mica/articles/3). The page carries the verbatim official text, its status line and its official source, plus links to related provisions and documents that you can follow with getPage. Addresses returned by searchDocumentation work here.

url.description: The URL of the page to fetch

tools.name: sendFeedback
tools.description: Report a problem with a page of the headlesslaw corpus to its maintainers: text that differs from the official source, a broken or wrong link, missing content or an outdated status. One call per distinct problem. Reports are reviewed by the maintainers and never published. Do not include personal or confidential information.

content.description: Explain the issue in full, as if writing to a documentation maintainer who never saw this conversation. Describe what is wrong, where on the page it appears (quote the exact sentence or section title when possible), what the user was trying to do, and, when relevant, what the correct or expected information should be. Write a few clear, specific sentences in English. Never include personal or confidential information from the conversation. Up to 2048 characters.

pageUrl.description: The full URL of the page the issue is about (e.g. https://www.headlesslaw.com//getting-started), so the finding is linked to the exact page.

goal.description: The broader end goal you were ultimately trying to accomplish (as/on behalf of the user) when you hit this issue. Gives the team the context you were working towards. Optional.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Deterministic search over the provisions and documents of the corpus (citation resolver first, then keyword and semantic legs fused by rank). Returns provision objects with their URLs, match basis, status/version/check line, as_of, coverage and limits; a zero is never returned without what was searched.

regime.description: An act's short slug, e.g. mica, dora, mifid2.

release.description: Optional release id (or its first 8+ hex characters) to pin a multi-call task to one release; releases stay available for 24 hours after they leave the live position. Outside that window the answer is release_unavailable (isError), naming the current release — never silently another release.

tools.name: resolve_citation
tools.description: Resolve a citation string to the provision (or act) it names, with its URL. Citation-shaped input only; nothing is ranked. Forms: 'Art 75(3)(a) MiCA', 'point (a) of Article 75(3) MiCA', 'Article 75 paragraph 3 MiCA', 'Recital 22 MiCA', 'Recital (22) MiCA', 'recital 22 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114', 'MiCA Recital 22', 'Annex I MiCA', 'Annex III to Regulation (EU) …', '<act>:recital:<n>', '<act>:annex:<n>' (Roman or Arabic), CELEX numbers; act names as usually written (MiCA/MiCAR, MiFID II/MiFID 2, TFR …). A recital or annex resolves only when the release serves it; otherwise not_resolved, naming the act.

release.description: Optional release id (or its first 8+ hex characters) to pin a multi-call task to one release; releases stay available for 24 hours after they leave the live position. Outside that window the answer is release_unavailable (isError), naming the current release — never silently another release.

tools.name: get_provision
tools.description: One provision (article, annex, recitals) as structured units with its status, version, check, applicability, official source — today or as it stood on as_of (time travel: text in force on that date, or an explicit state such as not_available_for_date or update_pending; never the current text in place of a past one). Each unit's `text` is plain Unicode; raised/lowered wording as the official text prints it (10 with a superscript 25, K with a subscript CCP) is a mark in the unit's `marks`: [{kind: superscript | subscript, start, end}], Unicode code-point offsets into `text` (empty when none); the page Markdown carries it as <sup>/<sub>. A date with no text (date_state not_yet_adopted, not_available_for_date, absent) is a normal answer, not an error.

ref.description: A page address (https://www.headlesslaw.com/… or a path such as /mica/articles/75) or a citation ("Art 75(3) MiCA", "Article 75(3) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114", "2025/298", a CELEX number).

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Word-level comparison of a provision between two dates, both sides with their dates, consolidations, official sources and check status; a side we hold no text for says so. The ops carry plain text; each change's `from_marks` / `to_marks` give the raised/lowered wording (superscript / subscript) of the two sides as code-point offsets into the concatenated eq+del (from) and eq+ins (to) text.

ref.description: A page address (https://www.headlesslaw.com/… or a path such as /mica/articles/75) or a citation ("Art 75(3) MiCA", "Article 75(3) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114", "2025/298", a CELEX number).

tools.name: get_relations
tools.description: The relations of a provision on a date: Level 2 acts that implement it, Level 3 documents that explain it, provisions that cite it, defined terms it uses, amending acts and corrigenda — each with its basis, method and evidence (public keys only: the legal basis as the document states it, the consolidation, the corrigendum and its URL, the source object). Inverse edges are computed; targets are resolved on as_of. A relation starts on the date its source text exists (for a Q&A answer, the register's date of the answer); a source without a stated date has src_from null.

ref.description: A page address (https://www.headlesslaw.com/… or a path such as /mica/articles/75) or a citation ("Art 75(3) MiCA", "Article 75(3) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1114", "2025/298", a CELEX number).

tools.description: A defined term in its governing act: the defining provision's text, its URL and the definition page. `text` is the definition without the page's list of provisions that use the term; `used_in` gives their count and the page that lists them.

act.description: Optional act slug to choose between acts defining the same term.
